en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad

Now that I think of it, so have I. 
Don't become too attached, however.

Life is meant to be a series 
of encounters and farewells.

Interacting with others is so enjoyable
because it is a once-in-a-lifetime event.

With that knowledge, let us fully 
enjoy this moment together.

I also look forward to traveling the 
country with you after we escape.

Humanity is beautiful... I wish for 
you to experience that truth firsthand.

With you there, I feel I shall enjoy
humanity's beauty all the more.
I cannot agree with that opinion...

Have you forgotten our promise 
to travel the country together?

It was a promise I made to you and 
you alone... I feel a bit betrayed...

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Korekiyo's inner thoughts...?
